{{Short description|Postal and delivery service address coding element}}
[[File:Eircode Routing Keys.svg|thumb|A map of Ireland's routing key areas]]
This '''list of Eircode routing key areas in Ireland''' is a tabulation of the routing key areas used by [[An Post]] and other mail delivery services for the purposes of directing mail within Ireland. A routing key area "defines a principal post town"<ref name="eircode">{{cite web|url = https://www.eircode.ie/what-is-eircode | title = What is Eircode? | work = Eircode.ie | date = July 2015}}</ref> according to An Post. There are currently 139 routing key areas in the country. This table does not include the second part of Ireland's seven-character Eircodes, known as the "unique identifier". These are unique to individual addresses and are not street-level identifiers, as is the case in other countries. There are currently 2.2 million of these codes.<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.locpin.com/blog/eirecode-five-years-on | title = Eircode: Five Years | work = Locpin.com| date = July 2020}}</ref>

==Scope==

Although Ireland's routing key areas take a similar format to [[list of postcode areas in the United Kingdom|postcode areas]] in the [[United Kingdom]] (including [[BT postcode area|Northern Ireland]]), they are not intended as a [[mnemonic]] for a county or city name, except for those used in the historic [[Dublin postal districts]]. Several towns and townlands can share the same routing key.<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.citizensinformation.ie/en/consumer/phone_internet_tv_and_postal_services/eircode.html | title = Eircode | work = Citizensinformation.ie | date = May 2020}}</ref> A routing key coupled with a unique identifier looks like this:

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; margin: 0 auto;"
! colspan="3" style="background:#FFFFFF; color: black;" | EIRCODE<ref name="eircode" />
|- style="background:#FFFFFF; color: black;"
|colspan=2| Routing key
| Unique identifier
|- style="background:#FFFFFF; color: black;"
|colspan=2| D6W|| PV38
|}

This corresponds to the unique address of

 [[Terenure]] Post Office
 128 Terenure Road 
 [[List of Dublin postal districts#Dublin 6 West (D6W)|Dublin 6 West]]
 D6W PV38
